scope: 11-video offline pilot; no motion ground truth or accuracy claim

definitions.sample: One classified Farneback flow comparison at production sampling cadence; null is no detected motion.
definitions.interval: Half-open [start,end); for corrected events a class owns its sample cell, with the final run extended to video duration.
definitions.short_run_suppression: A single A-B-A sample is relabeled A, including null/unknown; scan left to right without adjacent conflicting replacements.
definitions.minimum_duration: After singleton suppression, omit runs shorter than the named duration; do not bridge resulting gaps.
definitions.unknown_as_gap: After singleton suppression, omit unknown runs rather than emitting them.
definitions.coverage: Union of emitted event intervals divided by summed video duration.
definitions.overlap: Time with at least two emitted events, calculated from interval endpoints.
